source: FT-991A CAT Operation Reference Book, EX MENU table

items.name: DISPLAY COLOR
items.doc: 0: BLUE   1: GRAY   2: GREEN   3: ORANGE   4: PURPLE   5: RED   6: SKY BLUE

items.name: KEYER TYPE
items.doc: 0: OFF     1: BUG     2: ELEKEY-A     3: ELEKEY-B     4: ELEKEY-Y     5: ACS

items.name: TIME ZONE
items.locked: The time zone's CAT format is not described in the manual.

items.name: GPS/232C SELECT
items.locked: Selects what the radio's serial socket does: changing it can cut the connection.

items.name: CAT RATE
items.locked: The CAT speed: changing it would cut this connection (the app and the radio would disagree).

items.name: CAT TOT
items.locked: The CAT time-out: changing it can make the link drop.

items.name: CAT RTS
items.locked: Flow control of the CAT link: changing it can cut the connection.

items.name: AM OUT LEVEL
items.caution: Audio level the radio takes from its port in AM: a wrong value overdrives the transmitter.

items.name: AM PTT SELECT
items.locked: Which line keys the transmitter in AM: the app relies on it.

items.name: AM PORT SELECT
items.locked: Which port carries the AM audio: the app relies on it.

items.name: CW OUT LEVEL
items.caution: Audio level the radio takes in CW.

items.name: PC KEYING
items.locked: Which line keys the CW: the app relies on it.

items.name: DATA PTT SELECT
items.locked: Which line keys the transmitter in data modes: the app relies on it.

items.name: DATA PORT SELECT
items.locked: Which port carries the data audio: the app relies on it.

items.name: DATA OUT LEVEL
items.caution: Audio level the radio takes from its port in data modes: keep the ALC at zero.

items.name: FM OUT LEVEL
items.caution: Audio level the radio takes in FM.

items.name: FM PKT PTT SELECT
items.locked: Which line keys the transmitter in FM data: the app relies on it.

items.name: FM PKT PORT SELECT
items.locked: Which port carries the FM data audio: the app relies on it.

items.name: FM PKT TX GAIN
items.caution: Audio level the radio takes in FM data.

items.name: RADIO ID
items.locked: The radio's ID: it cannot be set.

items.name: RTTY SHIFT PORT
items.locked: Which line shifts the RTTY: the app relies on it.

items.name: RTTY OUT LEVEL
items.caution: Audio level the radio takes in RTTY.

items.name: RTTY MARK FREQ
items.locked: The manual's table is inconsistent for this item (its codes are not certain), so it is shown but not changed here.

items.name: SSB OUT LEVEL
items.caution: Audio level the radio takes from its port in SSB.

items.name: SSB PTT SELECT
items.locked: Which line keys the transmitter in SSB: the app relies on it.

items.name: SSB PORT SELECT
items.locked: Which port carries the SSB audio: the app relies on it.

items.name: SSB TX BPF
items.caution: Changes the audio band the transmitter sends: a narrow band can make the signal sound different.

items.name: SPECTRUM COLOR
items.doc: 0: BLUE     1: GRAY     2: GREEN     3: ORANGE     4: PURPLE     5: RED     6: SKY BLUE

items.name: WATER FALL COLOR
items.doc: 0: BLUE     1: GRAY     2: GREEN     3: ORANGE     4: PURPLE     5: RED     6: SKY BLUE     7: MULTI

items.name: HF TX MAX POWER
items.caution: Limits the power the radio can transmit with on HF; the TX Power slider cannot go above it.

items.name: 50M TX MAX POWER
items.caution: Limits the power the radio can transmit with on 50 MHz.

items.name: 144M TX MAX POWER
items.caution: Limits the power the radio can transmit with on 144 MHz.

items.name: 430M TX MAX POWER
items.caution: Limits the power the radio can transmit with on 430 MHz.

items.name: TUNER SELECT
items.caution: Chooses the antenna tuner the radio uses.

items.name: EMERGENCY FREQ TX
items.caution: Allows the radio to transmit on the emergency frequencies. Leave it as it is unless you need it.
